label: preparing
what: A confidential jubilee/surprise celebration for the mayor's forty years of service: 200 fresh loaves and eight lanterns in the great hall, with the mayor discreetly brought there at 18:00. The mayor was kept unaware of the celebration itself, although told about a routine hall lighting inspection and eventually suspected preparations. Baker supplied the final 44 loaves in exchange for planks and lanterns; others coordinated bread, supplies, lighting, delivery, and escort.
